“

A throwable device engineered to bounce when hitting the ground, releasing bursts of electricity on each impact. Warning: may bounce unpredictably.

— Armory Description

The G-31 Arc is a Special Throwable that fires arcs in a similar manner to the De-Escalator.

Procurement

G-31 Arc is unlocked on the 3rd page of the Control Group Premium Warbond for 65 Medals.

Tactical Information

  • G-31 Arc has insufficient demolition force to destroy Bug Holes or Automaton Fabricators, and can even jump back out of a Fabricator's vent to kill Helldivers.
    • Like other throwables without sufficient demolition force, Helldivers are advised to equip an alternative means of dealing with these structures such as the Exploding Crossbow, Grenade Pistol, or offensive stratagems.
  • When the G-31 Arc is thrown, it lies on the ground momentarily before expelling electric arcs a total of 5 times before wearing out. Each time it expels these arcs, it bounces in a small area, but depending on terrain, can be unpredictable.
    • Like the A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower, Helldivers can avoid attacks from the G-31 Arc by assuming a prone position or diving.
  • Unlike most grenades, the G-31 Arc only activates after it is thrown or accidentally dropped. It cannot be "cooked."
  • The G-31 Arc is great for combating hordes of enemies; while not ideal against heavier enemies, it can damage and even stun them.
  • While the listed damage is 100, this indicates the damage per arc. In practice the G-31 has the potential to deal massive damage by hitting single targets with multiple electric arcs.
